title: purple-jmap design note: Adium viability, architecture, JMAP Chat mapping
description: Write the purple-jmap design note for Mark's review (model: mimid docs/design/purple-mimi.md, same structure and sourcing discipline: cite versions read, mark guesses). Cover: (1) Adium today: latest release, maintenance, bundled libpurple version, third-party protocol plugin loading, macOS signing/notarization, Apple silicon; go/no-go for Adium with evidence. (2) Pidgin 2.14 / libpurple 2 and Pidgin 3 status (reuse purple-mimi's findings). (3) Architecture: Rust library with C ABI (jmap-base-client session/auth, jmap-chat-client, jmap-websocket for chat-wss live events) under thin C glue; what can be shared with purple-mimi. (4) Mapping: JMAP Chat Chat/Space/Message/ChatContact/PresenceStatus/typing to libpurple accounts, buddy list, IMs, chats, presence, typing, file transfer (blob). (5) Auth: Basic/app password vs OAuth; credential storage via libpurple's keyring. (6) Open questions for Mark (repo, license, priority vs purple-mimi). Nothing built yet.
